sources.title: Employee Handbook 2026
sources.text:
## 4. Travel and Expenses

Business travel must be booked through the corporate travel portal. Employees should choose the most economical option that meets the business need.

The meal per diem for domestic business travel is EUR 64 per day. The meal per diem for international business travel is EUR 95 per day.

Economy class must be booked for all flights shorter than 6 hours. Hotel accommodation is capped at EUR 210 per night outside capital cities.

Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of the expense being incurred. Use of a private car for business is reimbursed at EUR 0.42 per kilometre.

sources.title: Employee Handbook 2026
sources.text:
## 5. Information Security

Every employee is responsible for protecting company and customer information. The Information Security Office publishes detailed standards on the intranet.

Passwords for company accounts must be at least 14 characters long. Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for all remote access to company systems.

Suspected security incidents must be reported to the Security Operations Centre within 2 hours of discovery. Workstations must lock automatically after 5 minutes of inactivity.

All employees must complete phishing awareness training every quarter.
